representative_evidence.quote_en: Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, source ACL, action and separation of duties. Apply checks at edge, domain transaction, retrieval, tool dispatch and publication as applicable; hiding or disabling navigation is not authorization.
